In 2017, DC became SHALL ISSUE for permits to carry concealed handguns. Previously it was nearly impossible to acquire a permit. Thousands of permits have been issued since.

In 8 years, Assault with a Dangerous Weapon (MPD) dropped 59% and Aggravated Assault (FBI) dropped 25%.
